questions.title: Can merchants refund payments that are still pending?
questions.question: Support already refunds pending payments from the dashboard. When a merchant's own system asks to refund a payment that is still pending, should the refund go through, or only payments that have succeeded be refundable this way?

options.label: Yes: pending payments can be refunded, same as the dashboard
options.clarification: Merchants can refund both succeeded and pending payments from their own system; failed payments cannot be refunded.

options.label: No: only succeeded payments; pending stays a support/dashboard task
options.clarification: Merchants can refund only succeeded payments from their own system; refund requests for pending or failed payments are refused and nothing is refunded.
